subject: Draft MAP: ACME POC - VPC / SSO / KMS dependencies

From: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil_sharma@redwood.com>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 1 Mar 2026 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: Recap + MAP draft (POC env setup dependencies)

Alex — thanks for the time today. Quick recap and next steps from our discovery so we have a single source of truth and can start the MAP: 

Summary (from call):
- Goal: 2-week POC validating latency and cost for ACME product search (search re-rank + embeddings).
- Success criteria: avg token latency <= 150ms, embedding throughput 200 reqs/min, and no sensitive data leaves your VPC.

Immediate MAP milestone we discussed: POC environment setup (VPC peering, IP allowlists, SSO/SAML, secrets/KMS).

Draft MAP milestone (attached: MAP-draft-ACME-20260301.pdf):
1) Network & Connectivity
   - Task: Establish VPC peering between ACME prod-net and Redwood POC VPC / or set up NAT with approved egress IPs.
   - Owner: ACME (network)
   - Redwood owner: Marissa Cole (solutions engineer)
   - Dependencies: ACME network approval, firewall rules, route table updates
   - Target completion: 2026-03-15

2) IP Allowlist
   - Task: Confirm egress IP ranges for POC and add to ACME allowlist
   - Owner: ACME security
   - Redwood owner: Nikhil Sharma
   - Dependencies: final list of IPs from Redwood host (we'll provide)
   - Target completion: 2026-03-12

3) SSO / SAML
   - Task: SAML integration for console access + admin SSO for POC support
   - Owner: ACME identity team (provide IdP metadata)
   - Redwood owner: Marissa Cole
   - Dependencies: IdP metadata, test user account
   - Target completion: 2026-03-10

4) Secrets / KMS
   - Task: Key management approach for POC (customer-managed KMS key or Redwood-managed envelope encryption)
   - Owner: ACME security / infra
   - Redwood owner: Nikhil Sharma + engineering
   - Dependencies: KMS policy, service account permissions
   - Target completion: 2026-03-12

Action items for ACME from our side:
- Please share network contact and SP metadata for SSO (Priya, please confirm).
- Please confirm whether you prefer customer-managed KMS or Redwood-managed for the POC.
- Sign-off on the attached MAP draft so we can schedule engineering time.

Attachments: MAP-draft-ACME-20260301.pdf (draft milestones), network-config-template.xlsx (network info template)

If you can share the network contact and a preferred target for completion of the POC env this week, we’ll lock resources. Happy to hop on a 20-min network sync with your team if helpful.

Thanks,
Nikhil

Thanks, Nikhil — good recap. Priya (CC) is our identity lead; she’ll drive SSO. For network: our network admin is net-admin@acme.com (cc’ing them on internal). We typically prefer VPC peering but can do allowlist+NAT if peering is blocked.

I’ll get Priya to send SAML metadata and our network admin will start the intake ticket.

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>

Cc: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil_sharma@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 1 Mar 2026 18:40:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Draft MAP + network template (POC env details)

Alex — forwarding a slightly expanded MAP and a network-config template to make the intake easier (attached: network-config-template.xlsx). Below are specifics we’ll need from your network team to start the peering/allowlist process: 

Required from ACME network team:
- VPC ID and region for peering (or the public egress IPs if using NAT)
- Approved CIDR blocks and any restricted ports (we typically need 443 outbound and 1024-65535 ephemeral for certain workloads)
- Contact + ticket number (if you already opened an intake)

SAML / SSO notes:
- We support SP-initiated SAML and will provide SP metadata. Minimal attributes required: email, name, groups (optional).
- Test user recommended: sso-test@acme.com with admin privileges for setup verification.

KMS / Secrets options:
1) Customer-managed KMS: ACME provides a KMS key ARN and service account permissions; we encrypt data at rest with your key.
2) Redwood-managed envelope: Redwood manages an envelope key; customer secrets are scoped and auditable.

Recommendation for POC: If compliance requires customer-managed KMS, option (1) is preferred. For speed, option (2) can be provisioned and later rotated to your KMS.

Proposed next steps:
- Priya / network admin share SAML metadata + VPC info this week.
- We schedule a 20-min network handoff (Marissa + your network admin).
- Once we have VPC/allowlist details, Redwood will provide final egress IPs and a doc with exact ports and routes.

On the quoting / resourcing side, we’ll hold the SRE slot for the week of 3/8 pending your sign-off. If you need an earlier start, we can provision a hosted ephemeral POC (no peering) as a fallback — see Sean’s note below.

Attachment: network-config-template.xlsx

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference

This lets ACME validate model quality and latency (app-level), while network team finalizes peering.

Also: ensure security questionnaire answers reflect the KMS approach we pick. Marissa — can you confirm which security artefacts we’ll need to share upstream (SOC2 section, network diagrams)? I’ll prep the security one-pager.

Thanks,
